notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). The skill covers Podman: Docker-compatible container and image commands, rootless setup, pods, systemd units and Quadlet, podman-compose and the Podman socket, kube play, networking, volumes and SELinux labels, registries.conf, registry login, and Buildah.

Medium: following it can make the agent change host configuration with sudo, writing sysctl drop-ins for user namespaces and for `net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=80` (SKILL.md:89-93, 120-121) and adding subuid/subgid ranges with usermod; `pip install podman-compose` (SKILL.md:208); enabling user systemd services and the podman socket; pushing images and `podman login` (credentials saved to ~/.config/containers/auth.json). Acceptable because these are standard, documented rootless-Podman setup steps on the user's own machine; the privileged sysctl changes are explicitly marked 'as root' / 'Enable if needed' and presented as alternatives, and nothing disables SELinux or other controls (it recommends :Z labels instead).

Lowering ip_unprivileged_port_start lets any local user bind ports >= 80; the user should approve that change. Related Skills (SKILL.md:379-381) link to sibling skills ../docker-management/, ../../orchestration/kubernetes-ops/ and ../../../security/hardening/container-hardening/ as optional reading only.
